changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwmedicationcategories AS SELECT mc.id, mc.name FROM public.medication_categories mc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwmedicationcategories TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwmedicationcategories FROM report_user;
